fee_notes: Single $50,000 lump sum Initial Franchise Fee. Additionally, $7,500 Activation Fee due at signing. Development Fee for multi-unit: $85,000 for 2 shops, $35,000/shop for 3-4 shops, $30,000/shop for 5-10 shops. All fees non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: All franchisees must pay to us a $50,000 lump sum "Initial Franchise Fee" when they sign a franchise agreement for a Millie's Shop.
